summary: Iteration 2 — Sprint 7-9 + Emergent Google Auth backend regression. Added 15 new pytest cases to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering Sprint 7 real country adapters (PT/SE/NO/DK/IE/BR/US), Sprint 8 LoA-downgrade detection + human-oversight override (AI Act Art. 14), Sprint 9 GitHub live-sync + Postman v2.1 collection export, and Emergent Google Auth (Bearer token via seeded mongosh session, /auth/me, /auth/logout, protected POST /issuer/credential and POST /compliance/gdpr/erasure). Also updated 5 legacy Sprint-1-5 tests that now hit auth-gated endpoints to inject the seeded Bearer header. Result: 49/49 passing.
action_items: Note: /api/auth/logout only reads session_token from cookie, not from Authorization header. This is intentional for the Emergent flow (browser clears its own cookie) but means CLI/Bearer-only clients cannot self-revoke a session. Consider also honoring Bearer to delete the row so API clients can log out.

Note: POST /api/issuer/nonce is public (no auth) while POST /api/issuer/credential requires auth. If the intent is to fully protect issuance, /nonce should also require auth so an unauth caller cannot exhaust the nonce pool.
Consider adding a 'GET /api/hub/postman-collection.json?download=1' variant with Content-Disposition attachment for easy Postman import.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/auth.py logout endpoint only checks cookies for session_token; the Authorization Bearer header path (used from strict-CORS hosts per the docstring rationale for /session) is not honored on /logout — inconsistent with /me and require_user which honor both. Suggest calling _resolve_user token-resolution helper and deleting by that token.

services/oversight.subject_fingerprint hashes lower('|'.join(parts)) but the join is on non-lowered strings — the .lower() is applied to the joined bytes so it works, but a subject whose name contains locale-specific uppercase (e.g. 'Ä') may produce a different case-fold than expected. Consider using casefold() explicitly and locking a normalization form (NFC).

routers/hub_extras._fetch_github_meta uses unauthenticated GitHub API (60 req/h). With 10+ slugs this can burn through the budget quickly under test load. Consider using GITHUB_TOKEN env if provided and a longer negative-cache TTL for reachable:false.

adapters/real_impls._SdJwtAdapter mutates the `disclosed_claims` dict in place — safe today because SDJWTVerifierV2 returns a fresh dict, but a future caching layer would cause corruption. Consider copying before mutation.

routers/oversight.OverrideRequest accepts arbitrary strings for `decision` and only validates inside services.oversight.override() by raising ValueError — FastAPI does not map ValueError to 422, so an unknown decision currently 500s. Consider Literal['accept','reject','escalate'] in the pydantic model.
routers/auth.create_session inserts a new user_sessions row on every /session call even when the same session_token already exists — potential duplicates. Consider upsert on session_token.

adapters/real_impls.AamvaMdlAdapter never applies country trust anchors — it uses the local MDocVerifier which trusts the platform's own issuer. Documented as out-of-scope, but the reachable=true stars on /repos/live should not be confused with cross-border cryptographic trust.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestCountrySprint7, TestHubExtras, TestAuth, TestOversight + seeded_session fixture; patched 5 legacy tests to send Bearer header for now-protected endpoints; fixed TestCountry.test_list_countries to expect 11 implemented=true)
test_credentials: Sessions are seeded per-test-run via mongosh; no long-lived credentials required. Fixture creates users of pattern test-user-<ts> with tokens test_session_<ts> and cleans them up in teardown.
seed_data_creation: Per pytest module: 1 users row + 1 user_sessions row (cleaned up on module teardown). Per logout test: 1 additional throwaway user+session. Downgrade test emits 2 issuance events and 1 downgrade record — subject fp namespaced by timestamp so re-runs do not collide.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Fixtures rely on `mongosh` being on PATH (verified /usr/bin/mongosh). BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, ISSUER_URL from backend/.env — both resolve to the same K8s ingress. Sprint 7 US adapter is mdoc-only; BR takes both formats; PT/SE/NO/DK/IE are sd-jwt only. Sprint 8 downgrade is detected only after TWO valid presentations for the same fp with strictly-decreasing LoA (high→substantial via pid→email vct). Sprint 9 /hub/repos/live may take 1-3s on cold cache — first run hits GitHub API; subsequent runs use in-memory 1h TTL. Auth: Bearer token from a mongosh-seeded user_sessions row works for /me, /issuer/credential, /compliance/gdpr/erasure. /auth/logout is cookie-only (see action_items).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. The 5 legacy test failures on the first pass were expected consequences of newly-added auth gating on /issuer/credential and /compliance/gdpr/erasure; fixed by injecting Bearer header from the seeded_session fixture.
